Application Data.NAME: CleanSweep Services, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CleanSweep Services, LLC provides comprehensive janitorial and cleaning services to commercial and institutional clients, including office buildings, schools, and healthcare facilities. Our operations focus on utilizing environmentally friendly cleaning products, with rigorous employee training on safety and handling of materials. We ensure thorough background checks and maintain strict supervision of our staff while on client premises. Additionally, we implement quality control measures and safety protocols to safeguard both our employees and clients' properties. Our fleet of vehicles is well-maintained, and all employees are trained in safe driving practices. Compliance with OSHA regulations is prioritized, and Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for all cleaning agents used on-site are readily available.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In the past year, CleanSweep Services, LLC experienced an employee theft incident on 03/15/2023, where a staff member was found to have taken $2,500 worth of client property during a cleaning assignment. The claim was reported immediately, and the matter was resolved with the employee's termination and recovery of the stolen items. The claim status is closed, and no further actions are pending. Additionally, a minor slip and fall injury occurred on 07/10/2023, resulting in a claim of $2,500 for medical expenses. This claim is currently under review, with the client receiving appropriate care. Total reported losses amount to $5,000.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Full-time security personnel on-site during after-hours operations to ensure safety and prevent employee theft.
